s1.syndrome_frame: Acute vision loss with intraocular hemorrhage and crystalline deposits
salient_findings: Spontaneous hyphema and vitreous hemorrhage in one eye
Presence of glistening crystals in the anterior chamber
Iridescent, needle-like crystals floating in the aqueous
key_facts: Patient is a young girl
Right eye is blind
Hyphema and vitreous hemorrhage occurred spontaneously
Multiple glistening crystals were observed in the anterior chamber
Number of aqueous crystals increased as hyphema resolved
Iridescent, needle-like crystals were seen floating in the aqueous
Morning glory optic disc anomaly was present
Low-lying detachment of the peripapillary retina was observed
Chronic retinal detachment was found after vitreous hemorrhage resolution
